combo.description: To close the distance on a target Q then instantly F E R as quickly as you can. Reactivate E while channeling your R, followed by an AA.
For a harder maximum damage combo Q AA then instantly E R followed by two AA's, reactivating E right before the second AA lands.
When in danger Q E R instantly then Flash mid R animation and reactivate E right after.
Another way to trade is to Q then AA and quickly E right after. AA again while making sure to reactivate E before the AA lands.
A nice and simple trade is to E then AA and reactivate E right before your AA lands.
If you can catch someone out Q E R as quickly as possible and reactivate E as soon as you can.
For a longer trade E then AA and reactivate E right before your AA lands, instantly Q right after then AA again.
